items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Uncle Tom's Cabin's got about ten songs he was searching around and recording people.

ctx.x: Yeah, but what sort of groups did he record?

He did gospel, spirituals, a lot of it was piano and organ combination with a few other things. He had good singers. I got some of it on tape. Some of (inaudible) because Uncle Tom's Cabin's got about ten songs he was searching around and recording people.
Well, I mean, it seemed to me from the time when I first met Edgar Battle, he was always talking about things like this, but nothing ever happened.
